thread:
rachel: Heads-up — planning a maintenance window this Sat 02:00–03:30 UTC for ap-south1 racks. Scope: staggered BMC firmware flip + soft node reboots across 6 racks. Goal is zero customer-facing downtime but expect transient capacity dips and a brief proxy restart on the control plane.

rachel: High-level plan: cordon+drain each rack, reboot nodes one cohort at a time, warm backfill from standby pool, run canary workload, then uncordon. We’ll throttle to keep <5% of GPU capacity offline at once.

tim: timeline looks good. who’s owning tenant routing adjustments? we should shift heavy tails off ap-south1 during canary. @anika? :eyes:

anika: I’ll own routing. Plan: advertise reduced capacity to traffic director and bump weighting to eu-west1/us-east1 for 45m overlap. Will add a 10m cooldown between cohort flips to verify latency.

rachel: thanks. ops-runbook-bot: attaching checkpoint checklist and failure scenarios.

ops-runbook-bot: CHECKLIST:
- preflight: verify standby pool >= 15% GPUs
- snapshot routing config
- confirm oncall pager coverage
- kv-cache seeding job scheduled

rachel: Command snippets for drains:
```bash
kubectl cordon node-xxx
kubectl drain node-xxx --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
```

tim: note: some preemptible pools may be reclaimed. prefer dedicated warm standby for backfill to avoid migration thrash. cost here ~ +$250/hr if we sustain 20% extra for 2 hours. @finance FYI.

leo: if we push traffic off-region, SLO risk shifts. I’ll add a short perf test after first cohort to check percentile tail latency. If p99 increases >50ms we abort and rollback routing.

anika: routing commands ready. Will flip weight via td-config with a staged ramp: 10% -> 40% -> 80% -> 100% over 40 min. Rollback hook included.

sana: customer comm draft: minimal impact expected, maintenance window Sat 02:00–03:30 UTC, some requests may see slight latency increases. Should I send now or closer to the date? :mailbox_with_mail:

rachel: send 48h ahead + reminder 2h ahead. add a note for enterprise tenants about reserved capacity options.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: ops/kv-preheat-job@main will run 15m before first drain. CI: green.

tim: failure modes: BMC fails to come up for 2 nodes in rack -> hold on next cohort, escalate to hw-ops, re-route traffic permanently off that rack until manual recovery.

anika: added an automated canary gate: if canary fails 3x in a row, routing will revert and we’ll pause.

rachel: final asks: oncall coverage (tim + leo), hw-ops standby, finance signoff for temporary warm standby cost, and customer comm schedule. I’ll post a final runbook tomorrow morning. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
